learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge of the concept of company, institutional and legal framework of the company. Organization and business management.
Identify the behavior of economic agents.
Know the concept of company, institutional and legal framework of the company.
Classify the legal forms in which business activity is carried out.
Define the parts and functions of the company.
Differentiate between various business organizational structures.
Identify human capital in the company.
Understand the commercial function and strategy of the company.
Make decisions about communication, distribution, product, and price based on the general strategy of the company.
Analyze the company from an economic and financial point of view.
Recognize the strategic process as a tool for competitiveness.
Analyze the competitive forces that condition the environment and competitive future of the company.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Understand and regulate one's own emotions and those of others to interact and participate effectively and constructively in social and professional life.

syllabus_topics: Topic 4: The Economic-Financial Structure of the Company
PART II. FUNCTIONAL AREAS OF THE COMPANY
Topic 8: The commercial activity of the company

assessment_methods.method: Activities during lectures and problem-solving classes (8 brief individual activities)
Preparation and presentation of a tutored group project
Bonus for completing an online course in informational competencies

assessment_rules: Students can choose between 'Global Evaluation' (one single exam for 100% of the grade) or 'Alternative Evaluation'. For the 'Alternative Evaluation' path, it is mandatory to have completed the group project and its public defense, at least 5 of the 6 practicals, and at least 6 of the 8 individual activities. A minimum of 0.5 out of 2.0 points from the theory part of the reduced final exam, and 2.5 out of 6.5 total points from this exam, must be obtained. Failure to complete 6 practicals results in losing the 5% corresponding to them. Fraudulent activities may result in a grade of '0' for the assessment and disciplinary action.
